text:
elaine: Thanks for coming today 1 1 quick follow-up thread to capture the bits we promised in Q&A + owners. I jotted a short action grid below; ping me if I got anything wrong.

feedback-bot: Recording + slides: https://redwood.cloud/ah/2812349999/recording · Slides: https://drive.redwood/teams/all-hands/2812349999/slides · Short transcript attached.

maria: TL;DR and a one-page FAQ are in the drive; I pinned both here. Also added a "questions we didn't get to" section.

henrik: On Dedicated GA timing: we still aim for early Q3, but we're switching to a three-stage canary: internal -> strategic partners -> invite-only customers. I'll own the canary gating doc and the rollback checklist. Owner: henrik. ETA: 2024-05-18.

zoe: SLA specifics: sales asked about SLO targets and credits. I'll work with legal + finance to draft a standard SLA appendix and a customer-facing FAQ. Owner: zoe (GTM). ETA: 2024-05-07.

sam: Private deployment pilot: proposed checklist includes KMS integration checklist, upgrade path test, and an offline install dry-run. I'll spin up a pilot board and request infra/security slots. Owner: sam. Pilot window: 2024-06-101-24.

devex: SDK compatibility note: we're committing to major-semver guarantees and will ship an "API shim" for the two most common breaking patterns to ease migration. Devex will publish migration recipes (py/js) and a compat test harness. Owner: devex. ETA: 2024-04-30.

maria: Compact action list added to follow-up doc (copied here):
```
- Henrik: publish Dedicated canary plan + rollback checklist (due 2024-05-18)
- Zoe: SLA appendix draft + customer FAQ (due 2024-05-07)
- Sam: private pilot board + install checklist (pilot 2024-06-10)
- Devex: API shim plan + migration recipes (due 2024-04-30)
- Maria: publish TL;DR, pin assets, and collect unanswered Qs (done)
```

henrik: Ack 1 will post the canary gating criteria and the automated checks we'll run.

zoe: Starting an SLA draft and will share a customer-friendly one-pager for review.

sam: Opening the pilot board now; inviting infra, security, and support.

devex: Working on a small shim package and migration examples; will drop links when the first PR is ready.

maria: If you asked a question during the live Q&A that didn't get answered, reply here and I'll add it to the unanswered list for leadership to address. Also flag if an ETA is unrealistic so we can re-prioritize. Thanks for the quick turnaround, everyone! :sparkles:
